weather_report:
Dawn in Subiaco arrives quietly, the air cool and clean-edged, with the horizon beginning to pale. Forecasts for the morning promise a cloudless vault, so expect a bright, lucid start and excellent visibility once the sun lifts. It will be properly sunny; UV will ramp up quickly after sunrise and trend high by late morning, so the day will feel gentle in the shade but fierce on bare skin.

Dress for an easy spring morning: light layers you can shed, sunglasses, a brimmed hat, and sunscreen if you’re out past breakfast. It’s a good window for ordinary pleasures—an unhurried walk before the heat sharpens, hanging the washing to sip the first light, cycling the short commute, or claiming a small table outdoors for coffee while the streets warm. As the sun strengthens, keep to patches of shade and let the clear, blue day do its quiet work.
